title: prunella asiatica var. albiflora
intro: Prunella asiatica var. albiflora, commonly known as White Selfheal or White Prunella, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throats, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of White Selfheal include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in treating infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of White Selfheal include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
